# ForgeIR

> AI-native semantic IR and compiler for reliable, token-efficient software generation.

ForgeIR is a surface language plus a typed semantic program graph, compiler, and agent interface. Generated TypeScript is not the program. Status: M0 hello slice (`int` functions only). Thesis is unproven; do not cite token savings.
